description: This is a Java test source file for the GestureTypingDetector class, containing unit tests for gesture typing recognition, including path testing, word filtering, and curvature calculations.

classes.name: GestureTypingDetectorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the GestureTypingDetector functionality, including gesture path recognition, word filtering, and curvature calculations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loads a keyboard, and sets up the GestureTypingDetector with predefined words and states.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Disposes of the subscription to the detector's state to clean up after tests.

methods.name: testHappyPath
methods.description: Tests the gesture detection for a typical path, verifying the correct candidate words are suggested.

methods.name: testTakesWordFrequencyIntoAccount
methods.description: Verifies that word frequency influences the candidate suggestions order.

methods.name: testFilterOutWordsThatDoNotStartsWithFirstPress
methods.description: Ensures that only words starting with the first pressed key are suggested.

methods.name: testCalculatesCornersInBackground
methods.description: Checks that background processing correctly updates the detector's loading state.

methods.name: testCalculatesCornersInBackgroundWithTwoDictionaries
methods.description: Verifies background corner calculation with multiple dictionaries, currently ignored.

methods.name: testCalculatesCornersInBackgroundWithTwoDictionariesButDisposed
methods.description: Tests background corner calculation with multiple dictionaries and disposal, currently ignored.

methods.name: testCalculatesCornersInBackgroundWithTwoDictionariesButDestroyed
methods.description: Checks that destruction resets the detector's state properly.

methods.name: testHasEnoughCurvatureStraight
methods.description: Tests the curvature detection logic for a straight line, expecting insufficient curvature.

methods.name: testHasEnoughCurvature90Degrees
methods.description: Tests the curvature detection for right angles, expecting sufficient curvature.

methods.name: testHasEnoughCurvature180Degrees
methods.description: Tests the curvature detection for a 180-degree turn, expecting sufficient curvature.

methods.name: testHasEnoughCurvature15Degrees
methods.description: Tests the curvature detection for a small angle (~15 degrees), expecting sufficient curvature.

methods.name: testHasEnoughCurvature9Degrees
methods.description: Tests the curvature detection for a small angle (~9 degrees), expecting insufficient curvature.

methods.name: generatePointsStreamOfKeysString
methods.description: Generates a stream of points representing the gesture path for a given string based on key positions.
